questions: How many devices did you fabricate and cool down, how many reached a sweet spot in both chains, and how many showed coherent parity oscillations?
Why were the others set aside?
Which ranges did you measure beyond the ones shown, for example B|| other than 150 mT, hybrid-gate detuning beyond the 0.5 mV windows of Fig. 3d-g, and pulse durations beyond 80 ns?
What does the second-best tuning in the main cooldown look like in both parity manifolds?
How many sweet spots (QD orbitals and Andreev bound state configurations) did you find and try in each cooldown, and how many gave matching even and odd frequencies?
What are the Zeeman, charging and Andreev bound state energies at the sweet spot, so a reader can place it in the microscopic models where false poor man's Majoranas appear?
The even and odd frequencies "typically agree" to about 5% (p. 6): over how many tunings, and can the φ ≈ π data (Fig. 2e, Fig. ED6i-n) bound λL and λR separately?
Fig. 2e followed "a charge jump" and "increased instability" (p. 24), with retuning at nine fields: were any sweeps repeated or set aside, and how does it compare with Fig. ED7o?
